title: FalconEvent payload: hermes.signal_state (v1)
description: Typed payload schema for registered FALCON event family 'hermes.signal_state'. Deliberately minimal, per the mandate's own instruction: this schema validates only identity/structural/searchable fields, never HERMES's actual indicator/regime VALUES (RSI, EMAs, ATR, Bollinger Bands, support/resistance levels, etc.) -- those live entirely inside the full original HERMES JSON, preserved byte-for-byte via the binary-field pipeline mechanism (see deploy/README.md's PID-05 'Isolated native large-payload proof' section), never structurally validated or interpreted here. signal_natural_key is the only required property -- see its own description for why, and why this does not contradict PID-05's own Section 9/D.6 finding that HERMES has no natural stable EVENT identity.
